about_the_game:
This DLC includes combat supplies, weapons, a safe container, hideout upgrades, and EZD. It enhances your battlefield survivability and strengthens your combat power, ensuring you are fully prepared to face the challenges ahead.

Pack Includes:

  • Safe container：

    • Ganymede container (10 slots space)

  • Hideout:

    • All merchants below Trust-Level 2 will be upped to level 2. (Except Johnny)

    • Unlock Area: Workshop

    • Unlock Area: Storage Room A

    • Unlock Area: Shooting Range

    • Unlock facility: Intel Center

    • HQ Power Fuel Can L (2 pcs.)

  • Storage box:

    • Collection Box (1 pcs.)

    • Mag & Attachment Box (1 pcs.)

    • 556x45 Ammo box (1 pcs.)

    • 762x39 Ammo box (1 pcs.)

  • High value Items:

    • Gold cup (4 pcs.)

  • Weapons:

    • EVO3 9x19mm SMG (1 pcs.)

    • G18C 9x19 automatic pistol (2 pcs.)

    • SECA16 5.56x45 assault rifle (1 pcs.)

    • Malyuk545 5.45x39 carbine rifle (1 pcs.)

    • AR STANAG Mag 5.56x45 30-round (4 pcs.)

    • P-Mag 5.45x39 30-round (4 pcs.)

    • G18C 9x19 Mag 17-round (6 pcs.)

    • EVO3 9x19 Mag 30-round (3 pcs.)

    • F-1 Hand grenade (2 pcs.)

    • M18 smoke grenade Yellow (2 pcs.)

    • Tango Down (foregrip attachment) (4 pcs.)

    • LOMIO8T (optic attachment) ( 2 pcs.)

    • HRMA (optic attachment) ( 2 pcs.)

    • PEQ Laser (Tactical attachment) ( 2 pcs.)

  • Gears:

    • JPC (lv.4 Armor) (2 pcs.)

    • Rampage(lv.4 Armor) (2 pcs.)

    • ACH helmet(lv.4 Helmet) (2 pcs.)

    • EliteOps Backpack (2 pcs.)

    • Robinson BFM Backpack (1 pcs.)

    • HyperTec StorageBag (1 pcs.)

    • Mag Pouch M (8 pcs.)

    • Grenade Pouch (2 pcs.)

    • Mag Double Pouch (4 pcs.)

    • Mag Pouch S (4 pcs.)

  • Ammo：

    • 5.56x45mm MK318 (15Rounds) (15 pcs.)

    • 9x19mm Pst (15Rounds) (15 pcs.)

    • 5.45x39mm PP (15Rounds) (15 pcs.)

  • Medical Items：

    • M.I.C.A. Device (2 pcs.)

    • Suturing Instrument R2 (2 pcs.)

    • Bandage (8 pcs.)

    • Medical Syringe (4 pcs.)

    • Military Syringe (2 pcs.)

    • Painkiller L2 (2 pcs.)

  • Provision:

    • Compact Ration (2 pcs.)

    • Sausage (4 pcs.)

    • Meat can L (4 pcs.)

    • Water bottle (4 pcs.)

The safe container unlocks immediately upon acquisition. Use the safe container panel in the hideout to manage your containers.

Unlocking Facilities will not affect the already-unlocked status and will not cause downgrades.

Items included in this DLC will be sent via multiple in-game mails. Please check your mailbox after purchase to claim your items.

DLC contents will be reissued after each data reset, its actual content is subject to change in future updates.
